main_text.l: pugnata primi sententia; cum hïs eadem sit ratio totius quantitatis, &
partis ejus, & si quantitas identificetur cum materia, vt probatum est, de-
structa parte quantitatis destruitur pars materiæ: Quibus adde quòd vel-
illa noua pars quantitatis recipitur in materia in qua erat præcedens
quantitas, vel manet sine materia & subjecto; Si primum, penetrabitur
cum alia quantitate in eadem materia; si secundum, accidens erit natura-
liter sine subjecto, nec extendet materiam, cum in ea non recipiatur,
quæ omnia sunt absurda.
12. Tertia sententia, quâ dicebatur rarefactionem & condensationem
fieri per productionem nouæ qualitatis, scilicet raritatis aut densitatis, cu-
jus beneficio corpus eandem materiam & quantitatem retinens, occupat
majus aut minus spatium, specialiter sic impugnatur. Vbi est occupatio ma-
joris aut minoris spatij, ibi etiam est major aut minor extensio actualis, vt
patet: Ar vbi est major aut minor extensio actualis, ibi est major aut minor
quantitas, cùm quantitas constituatur per extensionem: Ergo si in rarefa-
ctione sit major occupatio spatij, & in condensatione minor, sequetur in
rarefactione esse majorem, & in condensatione esse minorem extensionem
actualem, atque adeo majorem aut minorem quantitatem. Deinde, non sunt
multiplicanda entia sine necessitate: Sed nulla urget necessitas ponendi
nouam qualitatem; quod enim dicitur causa illius nouæ qualitatis, poterit
dici causa majoris aut minoris extensionis localis sine productione nouæ
qualitatis; & in quinta sententia facile omnia salvantur per introitum aut
exitum corpusculorum, sine vllius nouæ entitatis productione: Et non
est verisimile, per solam compressionem digito factam quâ condensatur
aër in folle aut vesica inclusus, produci nouam qualitatem aut entitatem.

page.notes: Running head: printed "SECVNDA PARS", transcribed with u for the vowel as per rule 5. Page number "184" printed at top left. Catchword "relictæ-" is printed at lower right; the hyphen may belong to the printed line break and is doubtful. Doubtful readings: "lect. 2." in the Thomas reference (the numeral could be read differently); "rarefacti" in the last line (accent uncertain, marked [?]); "Hieronymus de Mendoza" name reading. Printing error suspected: "Ar vbi" (probably "At vbi") is left as printed, and "hïs" is read with a diaeresis that may be a smudge. The last line ends mid-sentence and continues on the next page. Shown-through and watermark "Google" in the lower right corner are excluded.
